name: Crocoparc
hero_subtitle: Morocco's premier crocodile park and botanical gardens — a top family attraction just outside Agadir.

overview.title: Hundreds of Nile Crocodiles & Lush Botanical Gardens
overview.p1: Located just outside Agadir on the road toward Marrakech, Crocoparc is home to over 300 Nile crocodiles set within magnificent, meticulously landscaped botanical gardens. Entered through a giant stone crocodile head, the park offers secure walkways, viewing platforms, and educational exhibits detailing the life and habitat of these remarkable reptiles.
overview.p2: Beyond the crocodiles, the grounds feature five themed gardens filled with exotic cacti, giant bamboo, water lilies, and tropical trees from around the world. Shaded benches and winding paths make it a relaxing environment for visitors of all ages.
overview.p3: It makes for a fantastic family half-day trip away from the beach resorts. Plan your transport in advance with a grand taxi or excursion, and enjoy a coffee or snack on site before heading back to the city.

2.desc: Stroll through exotic gardens featuring giant cacti, bamboo groves, and tropical flora.

3.title: Play & Relaxation
3.desc: Children's play areas, souvenir shops, and shaded cafeteria terraces.

food.title: Park Café & Dining Options
food.p1: Crocoparc features an on-site snack bar and cafeteria overlooking the gardens where you can grab light meals, refreshments, and ice cream.
food.p2: For a more extensive dining experience, visitors typically head back to Agadir's main restaurant districts after their park tour.
food.li1: Cafeteria for sandwiches, salads, and snacks
food.li2: Shaded terrace seating amidst tropical foliage
food.li3: Ice creams and cold drinks ideal for hot afternoons
food.li5: Return to Agadir corniche or marina for a full seafood dinner later

1.title: Sun Protection
1.desc: Although there are shaded paths, the midday sun in the Souss valley can be intense. Bring hats, sunglasses, and sunscreen.

2.title: Transportation
2.desc: Located outside the city centre; arrange a round-trip grand taxi or book an organized half-day excursion.

3.title: Photography
3.desc: Great photo opportunities of the giant entrance, bridges, and basking crocodiles. Keep a steady grip near viewing glass.

q1.question: How long do I need?
q1.answer: About 2 to 3 hours for a complete visit of the crocodile enclosures and botanical gardens.

q2.question: Is it only for children?
q2.answer: No, while families love it, botany enthusiasts and wildlife lovers also enjoy the extensive gardens and reptile exhibits.

q3.question: How much are tickets?
q3.answer: Adult tickets are approximately 90 MAD, and children's tickets are around 60 MAD.

q4.question: Do I need a guide?
q4.answer: Not strictly necessary as the park is well-signed with informative boards, but guided tours offer extra insights.

q5.question: Is Crocoparc wheelchair accessible?
q5.answer: Yes, the main paths and walkways are wide and flat, making strollers and wheelchairs easy to navigate.
